race.comment: ZAHRANN (14) was excellent first up in the Heatherlie here over 1700m which is typically the key lead-in for this race. He was charging home over the final 200m and looks very well placed to 2000m with just 55kg. The consensus is that he needs to go close to winning here to assure of a place in the Caulfield Cup so expect he's wound up and very hard to beat. Stablemate SAINT GEORGE (3) is absolutely flying having won his past two, far too good with 61.5kg here last time out. The draw isn't ideal and perhaps he's the one to be ridden quietly this time but he can still win. ZAKOUMA (18) was good fresh and will be hitting the line while DEAKIN (11) is a two-time second-up winner so can progress off the fresh placing.
